Override this method in your own Scene subclass to implement per-frame game logic. This method is called automatically once per game step while the scene is running. It is empty by default and is the primary place to put logic that needs to run every frame, such as updating game object positions, checking collisions, or reading input state.

p.x: The current time. Either a High Resolution Timer value if it comes from Request Animation Frame, or Date.now if using SetTimeout.
The delta time in ms since the last frame. This is a smoothed and capped value based on the FPS rate.
